name: cfkanban-agent-skills
description: Portable cfKanban guidance and skills for daily collaboration, Owner administration, and safe Cloudflare deployment.

interface.shortDescription: Learn, use, administer, and deploy cfKanban with Agent Skills
interface.longDescription: Use cfkanban-howto for examples and guidance; cfkanban to find, create, edit, complete, reopen, and comment on Issues; cfkanban-admin for Owner project, access, and capacity management; and cfkanban-deploy for Cloudflare deployment, upgrades, and recovery. Project writers can change Issues; application administration requires the Deployment Owner, and deployment requires Cloudflare authorization.
defaultPrompt: Use $cfkanban-howto to show how to create Issues, change status, and add comments.
Use $cfkanban-admin to explain how I can manage projects and invite teammates as Owner.
Use $cfkanban-deploy to check what I need to deploy or upgrade my instance.
